description: Submit mail with existing credits: one credit per accepted recipient. Requires a Bearer API key. Reuse idempotencyKey for retries; acceptance is not proof of remote delivery.

inputSchema.description: At least one nonempty text or HTML body, up to 1 MB combined. At most 50 distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc.

attachments.description: Inline content only. Combined decoded attachment limit: 8 MB.

oneOf.description: An email address or comma-separated addresses
An email address or comma-separated addresses

from.description: Address or {email,name}. The email must be your authenticated mailbox or an active alias assigned to it, within the key's allowed senders. The display name changes only the visible From header.

headers.description: Only these two headers are accepted, case-insensitively. Duplicate names and control characters are rejected. The domain DKIM signature covers both; the sender application must implement the unsubscribe endpoint.

List-Unsubscribe.description: Angle-bracketed HTTPS or mailto URLs, separated by commas. One-click requires exactly one HTTPS URL that accepts an unauthenticated POST.

inReplyTo.description: Original RFC Message-ID, including angle brackets

references.description: Thread Message-IDs, at most 998 characters combined
